summary_en: NSD will cancel 3,000,000 common shares, or 3.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, on October 16, 2026, reducing outstanding shares to 83,000,000.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On September 28, 2026, NSD's board of directors resolved to cancel 3,000,000 common shares held in treasury. The shares to be cancelled represent 3.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, based on 75,452,365 shares outstanding as of August 31, 2026. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on October 16, 2026, bringing total outstanding shares to 83,000,000. Following the cancellation, treasury stock is expected to represent approximately 9.3% of total issued shares.
